limitations: Each MB is integrated separately. No simultaneous MB–MB or RBC–MB hydrodynamic coupling.
Real RBC passage and RBC-resolved physiological blood suspension remain unresolved.
Long acquisition assumes C_MB=8.5e12 m^-3 throughout; not a post-bolus PK prediction.
P6.5 sphere-normal rule only; handoff event-time convergence and production dt are not established.
Admission guards, stationary numerical states and safety stops are retained, never linked to an outlet.
The full mesh is displayed; missing outlet trajectories are not synthesized or claimed as reconstructed.
Camera orbit, time compression/cuts and linear display interpolation do not create new solver states.
No acoustic image formation, measured localization noise, detection loss or full PK model.
